name: robots/rigbetellabs__tortoisebot
title: TortoiseBot Ignition simulation environment
intro: TortoiseBot Ignition simulation environment, adapted from rigbetellabs/tortoisebot. It reads `read_odometry`, `read_clock` and `read_scan`; runs `publish_velocity` and `resume_simulation`. `publish_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity command on /cmd_vel; the publication is transmission only and returns no motion or stop confirmation. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
